scope: Offline explicit-product evidence trace. No change to the original conservative scores, question packages, rubrics or activation. Synthetic cases are not learner trials.

editorialDecisions: Record only observable explicit multiplicands and an exact product. The trace is private diagnostic evidence, not separately awarded marks or a source assertion about a learner.
Correct explicit multiplicands may be retained as evidence when evaluation is rounded, inconsistent, scaled or otherwise unresolved. The total remains null and needs review.
Missing multiplicands, competing additional working, unsupported expressions or an alternative to the generated stated g cannot establish this bounded substitution trace.
Recognise a mass power-of-ten ratio only from explicit working, never from the final number alone. Preserve the existing one-deduction scoring path.
Original g acceptance remains separate from the generated prompt's explicitly selected g. Do not import concessions without adaptation review.
Do not turn an evidence label into a minimum score or claim that unresolved notation has been calibrated.
blockers: Rounding, implied method, competing working and free-text interpretation need calibrated decisions.
Explicit-g and table/prose adaptations and task difficulty remain unvalidated for live assessment.
